headline: Approved renovations to the Fifield Room and advanced a cybersecurity readiness assessment order.
summary: Discussion covered MCAS results, including a decline in ELA performance, and the district's plans to review the data. The committee also received the high schools' accreditation letter and approved a principal pay increase for FY26-27.
decisions: Referred the HPS staff handbook update on Protected Act information and virtual meeting platforms to the Policy and Governance Subcommittee, 9-0.
Referred the family handbook update, Protected Act, and Code of Conduct to the Policy and Governance Subcommittee, 9-0.
Approved nominating Ms. Lubold as delegate and Ms. Molina as alternate delegate for the MASC Conference, 9-0.
Approved receiving the memo on cyber liability insurance coverage, 9-0.
Approved receiving the NEASC accreditation letter for Holyoke High North and Holyoke High Dean, 9-0.
Approved receiving the communication on the Donahue ES construction schedule extension, 9-0.
Approved out-of-state travel for Shabazz, Fatimah of Opportunity Academy to attend a conference in Montgomery, Alabama, October 5-9, 2026, 9-0.
Referred the Nursing/SPED staff budget transfer for contracted services for salaries to the Finance and Operations Subcommittee, 9-0.
Failed, 4-5, an amendment to remove the timeframe from the order for a district preparedness assessment.
Approved, 7-2, an amendment removing the timeframe from the order for a district preparedness assessment.
Approved, 9-0, an amendment adding the word cybersecurity to the order for a district readiness assessment.
Approved the 8.24.26 School Committee meeting minutes, 9-0.
Approved the 5.7.26 Finance and Operations Subcommittee meeting minutes, 9-0.
Approved the recommendation for renovations to the Fifield Room, 9-0.
Approved the Final Principal Increase FY26-27 Performance, 9-0.
Approved receiving the June 2026 and July and August 2027 financial reports, 9-0.
Approved appointing Mr. Michaelsen as chair and Mayor Garcia, Ms. Lefebvre, and Mr. Sheehan as members of the Ad Hoc AI Subcommittee, 9-0.
Approved removing policies IA-Instructional Goals and IE-Organization of Instructions on second and final read, 9-0.
